devdoc.details: No upgrade/admin key. Data decryption still requires a trusted off-chain gateway.      The agent's ERC-8004 owner is snapshotted, and must still own the identity at use.      Scope identifiers MUST be opaque random values, never personal information.

checkPermission(uint256,address,uint256,.details: Not a receipt, reservation or permission to decrypt indefinitely.

devdoc.title: Aegis permissions and token payment vault

approvePayment(uint256,bytes32,address,u.notice: Extra, one-use payment consent. Does not increase the automatic spending cap.

checkPayment(uint256,address,address,uin.notice: Preflight for automatic spending; pay() also accepts an exact manual approval.

checkPermission(uint256,address,uint256,.notice: Read-only preflight. `actor` must be authenticated separately by the gateway.

delegatePermission(uint256,uint256,uint2.notice: Child limits are ceilings, not reservations. Every spend charges ancestors.

pay(uint256,address,uint256,bytes32).notice: Checks permission, consumes budget and transfers tokens in one transaction.

revokePermission(uint256).notice: Descendants fail their next check; no unbounded traversal or deletion.
